The History of VanderBeken Remodel
FIND US IN SNOHOMISH MAGAZINE

VanderBeken Remodel began as a perfect blend of passion, experience, and family tradition. Ron VanderBeken discovered his love for building while working construction jobs as a college student at Seattle Pacific University, balancing his studies with his desire to work with his hands. After years of teaching and gaining experience in custom home building, Ron decided to pursue his passion full-time in 1998, stepping into the role of project manager for a custom home builder.

Meanwhile, Jennifer VanderBeken grew up surrounded by the building industry, with both her father and grandfather as Seattle-area home builders. From job site cleanup as a child to office work in high school, Jennifer developed an intimate understanding of the craft. After a career as an elementary school teacher, Jennifer joined Ron in launching VanderBeken Remodel in 2007. Together, they combined their expertise, vision, and shared values to create a family-run design-build firm dedicated to transforming homes and enriching lives in their community.

Our Philosophy

At VanderBeken Remodel, we believe that every home tells a story—and so do we. As a family-owned business rooted in Snohomish County, our philosophy is built on trust, craftsmanship, and a genuine passion for transforming spaces into homes that reflect your unique lifestyle.

Our history is not just about building and remodeling; it’s about the relationships we’ve built along the way. Explore our story and discover what drives us to create a home remodeling experience you will enjoy, and spaces you will love for a lifetime.

Why We Do What We Do

At VanderBeken, we’re more than remodelers—we’re your neighbors, committed to creating spaces that inspire trust, joy, and pride. Rooted in a passion for education, we constantly seek new knowledge and ways to serve better, fostering teamwork and growth within our company and our community. Our dedication to excellence drives us to deliver high-quality, creative solutions that exceed expectations, while our focus on hospitality ensures a welcoming, personalized experience every step of the way.

We love what we do because it’s about more than remodeling—it’s about building relationships and transforming lives through beautifully crafted homes.

Our Mission

VanderBeken Remodel is committed to redefining the remodeling experience in Snohomish County by seamlessly blending hospitality with extreme customer service. Through our dedication, we aim to not only transform homes but also enrich the lives of our clients, fostering trust, inspiration, and joy in every interaction.

Our Values

Gratitude

We create a culture of service to others with joy and gratefulness.


Accountability

We practice accountability by being honest with ourselves and each other regarding our strengths and challenges.


Teamwork

We are building a community that works together for the success of each member.


Continuous Improvement

Individually and as a collective, we seek knowledge and growth in our roles to contribute to the success of the team and exceed client expectations.


Integrity

We are honest and do the right thing to build a culture of trust and respect.

Our Remodel Process

When you decide to remodel your home, you can expect a significant financial investment, but the end result will be truly remarkable.

At VanderBeken Remodel, we are dedicated to listening attentively and collaborating closely with you throughout the entire design and construction process, ensuring that your vision becomes an absolutely stunning reality.

Discovery
UNDERSTANDING YOUR NEEDS

Your journey with VanderBeken begins with a conversation. After an initial phone call to understand your goals, we invite you to our office to explore ideas for your home. Together, we’ll discuss your challenges and needs, asking thoughtful questions to uncover the heart of your vision for your remodel.

If we mutually agree we are a great fit, the next step is an in-home Design Assessment. During this visit, we’ll delve into the details, take measurements of your space, and finalize a Design Agreement to move forward with bringing your vision to life.

Development
CREATING YOUR VISION

This is where the excitement truly begins. Our design team, carefully selected to align with your specific needs, works closely with you to bring your vision to life. You’ll receive concept drawings, 3D renderings, a detailed scope of work, and a fixed investment price—giving you a clear picture of your remodel and ensuring every detail is accounted for before production begins.

Our goal is to provide you with complete confidence, knowing your home is receiving top-quality care with no surprises along the way.

Remodeled Reality
BUILDING YOUR DREAM

Production kicks off with the introduction of your dedicated project manager, who will be your primary point of contact throughout the construction process. You’ll also gain access to our real-time project management system, keeping every detail of your remodel at your fingertips. Scheduled progress meetings ensure you’re informed, your questions are answered, and you feel confident at every step.

To ensure your complete satisfaction, we will conduct a thorough walkthrough of your project, address any concerns, and follow up at 90 days and 12 months to ensure everything exceeds your expectations and continues to meet our high standards.

And we’re not stopping there! Our two-year warranty guarantees you can enjoy your newly transformed home with complete peace of mind.

Here’s to your new Home Sweet Home!

Why Design Build
Why Choose Design-Build Remodeling?

If you’re starting the process of remodeling your home, it’s natural to feel overwhelmed. From developing design concepts to selecting contractors and managing timelines, there’s a lot to coordinate. Traditional remodeling methods often involve multiple parties—architects, general contractors, subcontractors, and more—creating layers of communication and increasing the risk of missteps.

Interestingly, the design-build approach isn’t a modern invention; it dates back to pre-Industrial Revolution practices. Master builders, like the renowned Christopher Wren, seamlessly managed both design and construction, ensuring efficiency and cohesion—principles that still define today’s design-build process.

This is where design-build remodeling excels. By streamlining the process, it offers homeowners a smoother, more efficient, and cost-effective alternative to traditional design-bid-build methods. In this article, we’ll compare the two approaches and explore why design-build remodeling may be the ideal choice for your home transformation.

Understanding the Differences
Traditional Design-Bid-Build
Separate Entities: The process begins with hiring an architect or designer to create your project’s plans. Once the designs are complete, homeowners solicit bids from contractors to execute the construction phase.
Fragmented Communication: Since designers and contractors operate independently, homeowners must often act as the go-between to ensure everyone is on the same page.
Potential Cost Overruns: Budgets can spiral when unforeseen construction challenges arise, as contractors and designers may not have collaborated on the feasibility of the plans.
Longer Timelines: The sequential nature of this method can extend project timelines, as design and construction phases are not integrated.
Design-Build Remodeling
Integrated Team: Design-build combines design and construction under one roof, creating a seamless collaboration between designers, architects, and the general contractor.
Unified Communication: Homeowners work with a single point of contact who oversees the entire process, ensuring clarity and consistency.
Cost Efficiency: From the start, the team considers the budget and feasibility, minimizing surprises and aligning the design with financial goals.
Streamlined Timelines: Once the design phase is complete, your project moves forward more efficiently, reducing delays.
Key Benefits of Design-Build Remodeling

Simplified Process

With design-build, you’re not juggling multiple contracts or managing communications between separate entities. A single team handles every aspect, from initial designs to the final nail. This simplifies the process and alleviates much of the stress homeowners typically face.


Collaborative Approach

Design-build fosters close collaboration between the team and the homeowner. By working together from the outset, the design-build team ensures your vision, budget, and timeline are aligned, resulting in a cohesive plan tailored to your needs.


Enhanced Accountability

Since one entity is responsible for both design and construction, there is less room for finger-pointing if issues arise. The integrated team takes full accountability, ensuring quality and satisfaction at every stage.


Better Budget Control

In the traditional method, costs can balloon when designs exceed the budget or unforeseen challenges arise during construction. In contrast, design-build teams work with your target investment in mind from the start, providing more accurate cost estimates and reducing the likelihood of unexpected expenses.


Faster Completion

The overlapping of design and construction phases allows design-build projects to progress more quickly. While plans are being finalized, preparation for construction can already be underway, shaving weeks or even months off the timeline.


Tailored Solutions

The close collaboration within a design-build firm allows for more innovative, customized solutions. The team can adapt designs as needed throughout the project, ensuring the final result meets your expectations.

Is Design-Build Right for You?

If you value efficiency, accountability, and a smoother overall experience, design-build remodeling is a compelling choice. It’s particularly beneficial for homeowners who want:

A single point of contact throughout the project.
Greater control over the budget and timeline.
A more collaborative and personalized process.
Reduced stress and fewer logistical headaches.
Can I Bring My Own Design or Designer?

Potential clients occasionally ask if they can bring their own architect or interior designer to a project. We evaluate these requests individually to ensure effective coordination and confirm that we can maintain the highest standards of service and deliver exceptional results.

Historic home renovation is about thoughtfully enhancing your home’s safety, efficiency, and comfort—while honoring the timeless charm and character that make it unique. What Makes Historic Home Renovation Different from a Standard Remodel

Unlike standard remodels, historic homes often fall under local, state, or federal preservation laws that may limit certain cosmetic or structural changes. Because of these requirements, historic renovations require more than just permits—they need a team that not only understands the process and can navigate historical commission approvals and design reviews, but also strives to preserve the history and character of your home.

Remodeling your older Snohomish County home? VanderBeken Remodel provides the experience you need to guide you through paperwork and connect you with reliable, local experts, including:

Local Historic Society – to ensure all work is legal and aligns with local, state, and federal standards.
Architectural Historians – to evaluate your home’s timeline and identify significant additions worth preserving.
Conservators – to safely access and interpret historic documents related to your home.
Why North Everett and Edmonds Homeowners Trust Us for Historic Home Renovation
You’ll gain access to trusted preservation experts and resources, and our craftsmanship, combined with our long-standing relationships with specialty suppliers, helps you bring your historic home in North Everett and Edmonds up to today’s safety, comfort, and efficiency standards—without sacrificing the charm and character that make it truly special.
HISTORIC-APPROPRIATE MATERIALS & SOURCING

Preserving original features begins with sourcing the right materials. 

As your historic home remodel contractor, we’ll collaborate with manufacturers who craft replica antique and vintage finishes, from era-specific wallcoverings to detailed millwork, ensuring you get the perfect match.
You’ll benefit from our strong connections with suppliers of rare and authentic materials essential for restoring historic interiors, such as oak, walnut, and mahogany.
Whether you need to recreate or match the right materials, we’re here to help you preserve or restore original features without compromising on quality or aesthetics.
PROVEN LOCAL EXPERTISE IN DESIGN-BUILD CONSTRUCTION SINCE 2007

From your first consultation to the final walkthrough, you’ll experience a remodeling process handled with care, transparency, and a deep respect for your home’s history.

With deep roots in Snohomish County, you can count on nearly two decades of experience restoring historic homes in North Everett and Edmonds.

You can rest assured that before any work begins, we take the time to deeply research your home’s architectural style, original interior elements, and its place within the neighborhood’s historical context.

Let’s continue its legacy—together—and ensure your renovation honors both the past and the future.

Enhancing Accessibility for All Stages of Life: Do you plan to retire in your historic home? Incorporate aging-in-place solutions to make your home accessible to people of all ages and abilities.
Adapting Antique Layouts for Modern Living: Transform compartmentalized floor plans into open, relocated, or reconfigured spaces while maintaining their period style.
